{{Quote|Acklay Base Sea Lion, this is Shark Squadron Leader. Have located the fleeing fishhead colony. Am transmitting coordinates to start attack run.|Shark Leader|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 32">[[Legacy (2006) 32|''Legacy'' (2006) 32]]</ref>}}
'''Shark Leader''' was the callsign for the leader of [[Shark Squadron]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] and the [[Genocide on Dac]]. He fought in an [[Skirmish on Dac|underwater battle]] against the [[Mon Calamari Rangers]].

==Behind the scenes==
Shark Leader first appeared in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Legacy (2006) 32|''Legacy'' (2006) 32]], the first issue of ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''{{'s}} [[Star Wars: Legacy: Fight Another Day|''Fight Another Day'']] story arc.
